Black Myth: Wukong Release Window Announced


The Journey to the West-inspired action RPG title – Black Myth: Wukong has announced its release window of Summer 2024.



The release window of the game was announced in a stop motion video over on the official Black Myth: Wukong social media account on Weibo. Although, the specific date of when the game will release is not confirmed, so we can only wait for more news.

For the unfamiliar, Black Myth: Wukong is an action RPG developed by Game Science that revolves around the player playing as Sun Wukong from The Journey to the West Chinese novels. Even including a plethora of references from the original novels.

It’s also interesting to note that the team behind Black Myth: Wukong had also previously released a trailer during the Lunar New Year for the Year of the Ox. Perhaps we’ll be seeing one last trailer during next year’s Lunar New Year, but only time can tell.
For more details and information about Black Myth: Wukong, do check out the game’s official website here.

Black Myth: Wukong will release for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X | S, and Microsoft Windows.

reference_summary: Tindakan RPG Black Myth: Wukong, yang diilhamkan oleh The Journey to the West, telah mengumumkan tetingkap keluarannya untuk Musim Panas 2024. Pengumuman itu dibuat melalui video gerakan henti pada akaun Weibo permainan, dengan treler juga tersedia di YouTube. Dibangunkan oleh Sains Permainan, pemain mengawal Sun Wukong dalam RPG ini. Permainan ini akan tersedia di PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Xbox Series S, dan Microsoft Windows. Untuk maklumat lanjut, lawati laman web rasmi permainan.
